title: Classroom of the Elite Season 5 Announced
content: Classroom of the Elite Season 5 was officially announced immediately after the fourth season’s finale premiered. The first 4 episodes released all at once, making for a 90-minute special premiere of the new season. It ran for a total of 16 episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: The One Piece Anime Remake's 1st Teaser Trailer Reveals Mayumi Tanaka's Reprisal as Luffy
content: Netflix unveiled during this year's Annecy International Film Festival on Wednesday the first teaser trailer for The One Piece , Wit Studio 's remake of the One Piece anime for the streaming service, and it reveals that Mayumi Tanaka will reprise her role as Monkey D. Luffy.
author: ANN

title: New Conan the Barbarian Series Officially Revealed With First Look (& It’s From a Cartoon Network Legend)
content: Conan the Barbarian is set to return in an epic new animated series by Cartoon Network legend Genndy Tartakovsky. The definitive sword and sorcery hero, Robert Howard’s epic hero made his debut all the way back in 1932.

title: Amazon Shares First Trailer For Helluva Boss Season 3, Reveals Release Schedule
content: It should come as no surprise to see that Amazon Prime Video has gone all in on Vivienne Medrano’s “Hellaverse,” considering the success of Hazbin Hotel . Quickly becoming one of the biggest animated series running today, Charlie Morningstar’s universe didn’t just stop when it came to her hotel-based redemption quest.

title: The One Piece Just Dropped Its Trailer for New Netflix Anime Reboot
content: One Piece is now in the works on a new anime with Netflix rebooting Eiichiro Oda’s original manga from the very beginning, and Netflix is finally showing off the first footage of it in motion with its first trailer.

title: THE ONE PIECE Remake by WIT STUDIO First Trailer Revealed
content: THE ONE PIECE anime remake by WIT Studio has revealed the first teaser trailer ahead of its February 2027 release date. Fans as the Annecy International Animation Film Festival got a sneak peek at the event yesterday, when the Episode 1 visual was also revealed.

title: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World Anime's 2nd Promo Video Previews Ending Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Yoneori 's The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World ( Suterare Seijo no Isekai Gohan Tabi: Kakure Skill de Camping Car o Shōkan Shimashita ) light novel series started streaming the anime's second promotional video on Wednesday.
